rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Clovis's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s727_persons_2026-11-25_s727f.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.heading_not_in_text: The page the read held prints a requirements list but not the program's own heading, which sits on a page the read did not hold; the record takes the list as this program's by its title alone, and no page read has confirmed it.
gaps.lists_not_closed: A choice list prints no unit figure of its own, one that depends on another choice, or also takes courses from another list, so the lists alone cannot add the program's units.

records.words: List B also allows 'Any course from List A not already used' (3 units). | List A also allows 'Any course in Required Core not already used' (3 units), i.e. GEOG 2 or GEOG 6 if not used in the core.

program.section_heading: ASSOCIATE IN ARTS IN GEOGRAPHY FOR TRANSFER DEGREE (MAJOR #C.7300.AA-T)
outcomes: Recognize, identify and discuss the major geographic features of the regions studied.
Use a map to illustrate the geographic features of the regions studied.
Discuss the current major geopolitical and domestic issues in the regions studied using an international perspective.
careers: analysis using computer systems known as Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

blocks.name: List A: Select two to three courses
List B: Select two course (6 units)

records.words: The excerpt starts mid-section on page 145; the program heading, any program learning outcomes and earlier description are not in the excerpt. Outcomes left empty. | total_units 69.5-70.5 is printed as 'Total Units (prerequisites and core courses)'; it includes the prerequisite block (26-27) and the core blocks (12.5+7+11+13).

program.section_heading: Occupational Therapy Assistant (section heading not in the excerpt; text begins mid-description on page 145)

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
